definition: A close monochrome work portrait that makes a person and heavy machinery equally structural, using physical gesture, hard-edged form, and real industrial texture instead of cinematic staging.
lockedQualities: worker and machine share the frame
industrial texture is descriptive rather than decorative
adaptiveGuidance: Adapt distance and crop to the machine while keeping the worker's action readable; preserve real surfaces and avoid theatrical smoke or invented danger.

sources.title: Lewis Hine Power house mechanic working on steam pump
supports: The documented 1920 work portrait visibly embeds a mechanic inside steam-pump machinery and organizes labor through bold monochrome industrial geometry.
